answer: Verifiable Entropy-Gated Proof of Work Agents register using dynamic computational puzzles seeded by a blockhash drawn from a deep ledger. This prevents any precomputation of the work. During registration, the network releases a sudden zephyr of validation tasks requiring immediate proof generation. An attacker attempting to flood the system must solve every generated puzzle under strict time limits. The cost is direct hardware compute waste and immense electrical power expenditure per sybil identity, rendering mass generation economically unfeasible on raw shale compute clusters.
